## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: cyclicals and industrials showing leadership (ETN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +12.17%); NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +13.12%)) and major growth names rallying (MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%); NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%)); Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: Growth/Momentum.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads with strong breadth and top performers: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%). Industrials strong: ETN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +12.17%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +3.22%). Materials showing strength via NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.10% | 1M: +13.12%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weakest: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -4.87% | 1M: -8.68%) and SRE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -11.52%). Energy showing weakness/rotation with EOG BELOW TREND (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.28%) and XOM in CORRECTION (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +9.71%). Healthcare mixed/soft: UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.08%), ABBV BELOW TREND (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -2.82%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.53% | 1M: +17.92%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.46% | 1M: +23.67%), ETN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +12.17%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.61% | 1M: +11.76%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +2.48%). Leadership concentrated across Tech, Industrials and Consumer Disc — Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -1.32%), VST BELOW TREND (1W: -4.87% | 1M: -8.68%), ABBV BELOW TREND (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -2.82%), KHC CORRECTION (1W: -5.38% | 1M: +0.16%), SRE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -11.52%). Weakness concentrated in Real Estate, Utilities and select defensives.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.53% | 1M: +17.92%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.46% | 1M: +23.67%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.61% | 1M: +11.76%). Major divergence present (multiple big names with 1W ≠ 1M such as GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +7.22% | 1M: -1.15%), META RECOVERY (1W: +9.44% | 1M: -2.19%), TSLA RECOVERY (1W: +3.46% | 1M: -18.91%)) — watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is strong overall (1W: +7.24% | 1M: +4.60%) with several leaders: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +2.48%), but AAPL is lagging at BELOW TREND (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.31%) and META/GOOGL are RECOVERY — positive momentum but mixed internals.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are constructive (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +6.89%) with JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +7.77%) and V ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +6.60%) showing steady gains; sentiment flags around BAC highlight idiosyncratic risk but sector remains supportive of risk-on.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed to soft (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +2.42%): PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +10.85%) and LLY in RECOVERY (1W: +3.20% | 1M: -1.96%), while UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.08%) and ABBV BELOW TREND (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -2.82%) create uneven leadership.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to leading growth/momentum names (MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.61% | 1M: +11.76%)) and selected cyclicals (ETN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +12.17%)); reduce exposure to lagging defensives and utilities showing persistent weakness (VST BELOW TREND (1W: -4.87% | 1M: -8.68%), SRE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -11.52%)). Style: Growth/Momentum favored, but monitor the divergence set-up.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.53% | 1M: +17.92%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.46% | 1M: +23.67%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%) — momentum to follow. BEARISH: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.31%), CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.55% | 1M: -7.33%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.08%) — watch for continuation.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +7.24% | 1M: +4.60%) and Industrials (1W: +3.47% | 1M: +5.35%) for leadership continuation. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -2.72% | 1M: -4.22%) and selected Healthcare names showing dispersion (Healthcare 1W: -0.12% | 1M: +2.42%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%) holding this week’s breakout high for extension of momentum and MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%) to maintain above this week’s support to confirm trend. AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.31%) breaking the recent week low would signal deeper downside; JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +7.77%) clearing its 1M high would validate financials’ leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
EA (+90): headline on EA deal is VERY BULLISH; price action mixed historically but EA currently not in top performance list so monitor for follow-through. DD (+85): DuPont beat and guide is BULLISH and aligns with Materials strength — DD showing sector-confirming accumulation. LLY (+75): Eli Lilly raised guidance (BULLISH) while LLY is in RECOVERY (1W: +3.20% | 1M: -1.96%) — news supports further upside if momentum holds.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-55): legal hit is BEARISH while META is in RECOVERY (1W: +9.44% | 1M: -2.19%) — negative news but price rising is divergence (distribution risk). PANW (-50): China cybersecurity review is BEARISH yet PANW is ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.38% | 1M: +12.13%) — monitor for follow-through. KHC (-55): impairment-driven headline CONFIRMS weakness as KHC is in CORRECTION (1W: -5.38% | 1M: +0.16%).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with Growth/Momentum style favored; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.61% | 1M: +11.76%) showing leadership. Key risk: broad divergence (multiple mega-caps in RECOVERY like GOOGL (1W: +7.22% | 1M: -1.15%) and META (1W: +9.44% | 1M: -2.19%)) and headline-driven shorts in PANW and META create distribution risk to monitor.
